response: Time is a sandwich made in the morning and eaten at noon, the bread already soft where the tomato touched it, that version gone forever.
Language is a potluck, everyone arriving with something made at home, nothing quite matching, and yet somehow the table works.
Nostalgia is a cupcake from a bakery that closed, remembered as perfect precisely because you can never have it again.
Doubt is a piece of sushi left out too long, something that was probably fine an hour ago, might still be fine now, but you keep looking at it instead of eating it.
Hope is ice cream eaten alone after a breakup, ridiculous and insufficient and somehow exactly right, a reminder that small pleasures still work even when everything else doesn't.
